messages:
adrienne: FYI customer ACME (acct acme-prod) started seeing tool call errors after we renamed a function. They call `tools.call('nlp.summarize')` and get a 404 / "tool not found". Ticket: SUP-8421 :exclamation:
support-bot: New support ticket created: SUP-8421 assigned to @adrienne :ticket:
adrienne: Error payload: `{"error":"tool_not_found","tool":"nlp.summarize","req_id":"rq_9f2b"}`. Happening in hosted + their private deployment behind a proxy. Happens for multiple users at the tenant.
ryan: Any chance the client has cached the old name? We rolled rename last night right?
samir: I saw the rename job. We changed `nlp.summarize-v2` -> `nlp.Summarize` (capital S) to match model registry, and created an alias `nlp.summarize` that should map to the new name. Alias creation event went into registry stream at 1833960000.
maria: The customer says the call is to `nlp.summarize` (lowercase). If alias exists, should be fine. Could be a sync issue to Dedicated/private syncers.
samir: Looking at logs: our alias-propagator consumer crashed and missed a window around 1833965000; it restarted but there were a few messages it didn't ack. For hosted the reprocess job fixed it, but for private deployments the agent relies on push updates — some gateways didn't get the update. Observed this in `alias-propagator` logs: `WARN skipped change zk_seq=8423` and then later `INFO restart backfill scheduled`. :thinking:
adrienne: Customer on private deployment reported it's failing; Hosted customers mostly recovered. So mismatch between control plane and customer-managed nodes.
samir: Quick repro: curl to hosted API returns 200 for `nlp.summarize`, but curl to their private endpoint returns 404. On the private node, `registryctl get tool nlp.summarize` returns `not found`, while `registryctl list --pattern "nlp.*"` returns `nlp.Summarize`.
ryan: Is this a casing-sensitivity difference? Their private registry might be case-sensitive and our alias creation had capital S.
samir: Partly. Also found that during rename we accidentally included a zero-width space in the alias metadata key (unicode U+200B). Hosted normalizer strips it, but the agent on older private installs doesn't. That resulted in an alias that looks like `nlp.summarize` but with hidden char -> clients call plain `nlp.summarize` and miss it. :no_good:
maria: Yikes. How did the zero-width char get in there? Probably from a copy/paste in the ops script.
samir: Agreed. Root cause: ops script used a heredoc with pasted alias name, and our validation allowed invisible whitespace. Fixes: 1) immediate workaround: tell customer to call by tool UUID (we can return mapping) or create a temporary alias explicitly on their private registry; 2) short-term: push a forced alias-sync to their private nodes (we have a force-sync endpoint) — this will reapply normalized aliases; 3) long-term: add server-side normalization strip and validation on alias writes and add unit to detect invisible chars.
adrianne: (typo note) — adrienne: I'm going to send the workaround steps to the customer: - use `tools.call_by_uuid('tool_0a12...')` or - run `curl https://private-agent/acme/registry/alias -X POST -d '{"alias":"nlp.summarize","target":"tool_0a12"}'` if they have admin access.
ryan: I'll open a hotfix PR to normalization lib and add a migration that scans for non-printable codepoints in aliases. Will add an alert when alias-propagator acks drop.
samir: For immediate mitigation I triggered `POST /internal/force-alias-sync?tenant=acme` at 1834014500 and watched their agent logs: `INFO alias-sync: applied 6 aliases; normalized 1`. After that their calls succeeded. 
adri***enne: nice, can you paste the log snippet we can include in the support reply?
samir: paste: ```
[1834014521] INFO alias-sync: tenant=acme applied=6 normalized=1 details=["nlp.Summarize->tool_0a12","nlp.summary->tool_0b34"]
[1834014522] INFO gateway: reloaded registry cache; cache_version=3421
[1834014523] INFO request: rq_9f2b served status=200 tool=tool_0a12 latency_ms=48
```
adrienne: Perfect. I'll update SUP-8421 with root cause, mitigation, and timeline. Will advise customer to run forced sync if they see it again. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: SUP-8421 status updated -> investigating -> root_cause: alias_propagator_missed_msgs; mitigation: forced_alias_sync applied.
maria: Follow-up action items: - ops: scrub alias inputs on create (samir) - infra: make alias-propagator idempotent and add reshard/backfill (ryan) - support: add KB on private alias-sync steps (adrienne)
samir: I'll also add a small check in the rename tooling to reject names with control/unprintable chars.
ryan: I'll schedule the backfill run and add a one-off audit for tenants with private agents (scan for orphaned aliases).
adri***enne: thanks everyone. I'll close out the thread once customer confirms. :bow:
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: PR #4821 normalization-fix -> staging (ETA 12m) :rocket:
